title: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
description: William Chapman was attacked by the tiger after he entered its pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.

title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
description: Pope Leo had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican said.

title: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office
description: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
description: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
description: The school has faced an uproar over how it handled assault allegations brought by a woman known as Jane Doe.

title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder
description: Davis was found guilty last month over his role in the late rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in 1996.

title: 'If we don't scream, they won't listen to us': Student protesters speak to BBC in Paris
description: Student protesters in France have told the BBC's James Waterhouse that they will continue to take action until change has been made. The protests have now entered their fourth week.

title: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations
description: Guilfoyle said the allegations of improper conduct were false and that being ambassador was the "honour of a lifetime".

title: Football regulator says he would quit over any political interference in Man City case
description: The head of English football's independent regulator says he will resign if he encounters any political interference over Manchester City's future.
